title: Tiny, cute present with a bow
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='boxGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6b8a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e8436a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='lidGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff8fa6'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f05c7e'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='ribbonGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe566'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffc107'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bowGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff176'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffd54f'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Box shadow / base -->
  <rect x='20' y='48' width='60' height='42' rx='5' fill='#c2335a'/>

  <!-- Main box -->
  <rect x='20' y='44' width='60' height='42' rx='4' fill='url(#boxGrad)'/>

  <!-- Lid -->
  <rect x='17' y='36' width='66' height='14' rx='4' fill='url(#lidGrad)'/>

  <!-- Vertical ribbon on box -->
  <rect x='43' y='44' width='14' height='42' fill='url(#ribbonGrad)'/>

  <!-- Vertical ribbon on lid -->
  <rect x='43' y='36' width='14' height='14' fill='url(#ribbonGrad)'/>

  <!-- Horizontal ribbon across box -->
  <rect x='20' y='62' width='60' height='10' fill='url(#ribbonGrad)'/>

  <!-- Horizontal ribbon highlight on lid -->
  <rect x='17' y='41' width='66' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffec8e' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Bow left loop -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='30' rx='13' ry='9' fill='url(#bowGrad)' transform='rotate(-15 38 30)'/>

  <!-- Bow right loop -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='30' rx='13' ry='9' fill='url(#bowGrad)' transform='rotate(15 62 30)'/>

  <!-- Bow center knot -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='33' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#ffb300'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='32' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#ffca28'/>

  <!-- Bow left tail -->
  <path d='M40 38 Q34 44 30 48 Q28 44 34 38 Z' fill='#ffd54f'/>
  <path d='M40 38 Q36 43 33 46' stroke='#ffb300' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>

  <!-- Bow right tail -->
  <path d='M60 38 Q66 44 70 48 Q72 44 66 38 Z' fill='#ffd54f'/>
  <path d='M60 38 Q64 43 67 46' stroke='#ffb300' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>

  <!-- Shine dots on box -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='52' r='2.5' fill='#ffb3c6' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='56' r='1.5' fill='#ffb3c6' opacity='0.4'/>

  <!-- Shine on lid -->
  <rect x='22' y='38' width='8' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ffd6e0' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Small heart above bow -->
  <path d='M50 18 C50 15 47 13 45 14.5 C43 16 43.5 19 46 21 L50 24 L54 21 C56.5 19 57 16 55 14.5 C53 13 50 15 50 18 Z' fill='#ff8fa6'/>
</svg>
